what.text: This page follows refugees from Sierra Leone living in the Gambia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 100 Sierra Leonean refugees in the Gambia, 1.1% of all refugees from Sierra Leone.
France hosts the most Sierra Leonean refugees, followed by Guinea, Germany and Greece.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sierra Leone in every year from 1991 to 2001, with the RUF and AFRC among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1999 to 2003 and 2007 to 2008.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 4050 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 12044, at the end of 1999, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Gambia.
These are year-end totals for the Gambia only, reported to UNHCR.
